verdict.rationale: ClickHouse offers programmatic fleet primitives. clickhousectl can create and manage ClickHouse Cloud clusters and resources and launch local servers, an OpenAPI spec is published, and Cloud services scale to zero when idle, which keeps per-service cost down. Nothing shows that it is designed or priced for spinning up thousands of isolated databases per agent, tenant, or preview. missing for 10: evidence of cheap, fast creation at thousands-scale, per-tenant or per-agent isolation patterns, preview/branch databases, documented fleet-management API workflows, independent corroboration.
